items.title: Morris French Interview
items.q: With a guy called Man Creole and She-Cole.

ctx.x: With Pico? I say with a guy called Man Creole and She-Cole. That was before the 20's. He with Pico?
With Pico? With a guy called Man Creole and She-Cole. I think She-Cole played baritone on one. I don't know them.
I think he got some fellas way back there, man.
